joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior, but frontier models optimized for rationality are not ideal; need to model subjective values and irrationality.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年中：LLM 能模拟人类行为，但为理性优化的前沿模型并不理想；需建模主观价值与非理性。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; safety requires defense in depth and addressing cognitive monoculture.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年中：AGI 可能是分布式专业智能体社会，而非单一实体；安全需纵深防御并应对认知单一文化。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟的价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来，而非仅预测；合成面板三年内将超越人类面板。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI, not compute; AGI is far off.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，而非算力；AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data has limits.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练可提升前沿模型，但合成数据并非万能。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is strategic; humans must stay sovereign.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我警告 AI 是集权技术，数据是战略资源，人类必须保持主权。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement and agents are now real; scaling laws still hold.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我认为递归自我改进和智能体已切实可行，缩放定律依然有效。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并未变得更聪明；你需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI; the best people are editors, iterating from references, not starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具；最优秀的人是编辑者，从参考中迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，使一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise, launch at 80% complete.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，交付不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，完成 80% 就发布。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; raising venture capital is a trap.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高薪客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；筹集风险投资是个陷阱。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process of getting to an answer you don't yet know, often requiring longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes the model's thinking process.
tworek.zh: 推理是得出未知答案的过程，常需更长的思考时间；思维链用人类语言表达模型的思考过程，实现逐步解题。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula for modern AI, as envisioned by OpenAI since 2019; RLHF was crucial for making GPT-4 coherent and useful.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式，OpenAI 自 2019 年即有此愿景；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 的连贯性和实用性至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; current models lack self-correction, a key missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限；当前模型缺乏自我纠错能力，这是 AGI 缺失的关键部分。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation, requiring a new architecture; architecture is the key bottleneck for smarter AI, not just scaling data and compute.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应方面受限，需要新架构；架构是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈，而不仅仅是扩展数据和算力。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms will emerge; end-to-end optimization combining pre-training and RL is necessary for real-world performance.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一途径，更好的算法将会出现；结合预训练和强化学习的端到端优化对现实性能至关重要。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability and first principles thinking are key; becoming multiplanetary is life insurance for civilization.
elon.zh: 2021 年：强调火箭完全可重复使用和第一性原理思维；成为多行星物种是文明的‘生命保险’。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年：AI 安全需要监管和追求真理；特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink first implant; AI risk is lying, not superintelligence; population decline is civilization's biggest threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年：Neuralink 首次植入；AI 风险在于撒谎而非超级智能；人口下降是文明最大威胁。

elon.en: AI could surpass humans soon; 10-20% extinction risk; humanoid robots and space AI data centers are key.
elon.zh: 2025 年：AI 可能很快超越人类；10-20%灭绝风险；人形机器人和太空 AI 数据中心是关键。

elon.en: AI will exceed all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation; space-based AI compute is inevitable.
elon.zh: 2026 年：AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能；丰裕和通缩；太空 AI 算力不可避免。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and RLHF are key; near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型规模是进步核心，Transformer 和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是关键；近期担忧是虚假信息而非超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks; inference latency is now critical; data is not running out.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现优异，智能体式工作流可处理长时任务，推理延迟成为关键，且数据并未枯竭。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; next is automating ML via loops; context engineering and specialized inference hardware are key; startups should target hard problems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达初级工程师编码水平，下一步是自动化机器学习循环，上下文工程和专用推理硬件至关重要，创业应瞄准难题。

jeffdean.en: Consistent emphasis on scaling, algorithmic improvements, and specialized hardware; belief in practical applications over existential risks.
jeffdean.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是强调 Scaling（规模扩张）、算法改进和专用硬件；更关注实际应用而非存在性风险。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 聚焦重要问题，减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; iterative deployment lets society adapt; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；迭代部署让社会适应；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is the most precious commodity; governance and iterative deployment are key for AGI safety.
altman.zh: 算力是最宝贵的资源；治理和迭代部署对 AGI 安全至关重要。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心。

altman.en: Next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; startups thrive; compute demand uncapped.
altman.zh: 下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；初创企业繁荣；算力需求无上限。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but other verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但其他垂直领域将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体框架和工具已成为模型的一部分。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是统一的世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not hard; they can't capture all customers.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，创造更多机会而非更少。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强人类而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied reasoning and interaction.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AI 需要超越 Scaling，具备创造力、抽象和情感智能；世界模型支持具身推理和交互。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities, not automates intelligence; human agency and adaptation are key in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化人类能力；人类能动性和适应能力在 AI 时代至关重要。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; robots should specialize in narrow tasks.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出模拟对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成和评估；机器人应专精于窄任务。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months from now, not today.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved; engineers become builders, productivity up 200%.
boris.zh: 编码几乎已解决；工程师成为构建者，生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: AI agents drive exponential growth; non-engineers adopt coding tools heavily.
boris.zh: AI 智能体推动指数级增长；非工程师大量采用编码工具。

boris.en: Coding solved; bottlenecks shift to review, security, and idea generation.
boris.zh: 编码已解决；瓶颈转向审查、安全和创意生成。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy; less instruction, more empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 主动式 AI 具备记忆和自主性；更少指令，更多经验迭代。

jensen.en: We are at the beginning of a hyper Moore's law curve, doubling or tripling performance every year at scale.
jensen.zh: 我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，每年性能翻倍或三倍。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will increase by a billion times.
jensen.zh: 现在有三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增加十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI will not become conscious; it imitates intelligence, not experience. Fear of a single superintelligent AI is unlikely.
jensen.zh: AI 不会拥有意识；它模仿智能而非经验。对单一超级智能的恐惧不太可能成真。

jensen.en: AI is moving from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute; agentic AI autonomously plans and uses tools.
jensen.zh: AI 正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要 100 倍算力；智能体 AI 能自主规划并使用工具。

jensen.en: AI will not eliminate jobs; it elevates them by automating tasks. Radiologists and coders are more needed than ever.
jensen.zh: AI 不会消除工作；它通过自动化任务提升工作。放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence via Opus 4.5 enables long-running agents; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的智能跃升支持长时间运行的智能体；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter achieves Opus-level intelligence at fraction of cost; smaller models may cost more due to longer tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数以更低成本实现 Opus 级智能；小模型因任务耗时长反而成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding differentiates Claude; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为差异化优势；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability; safety enables pushback, making AI more useful.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，模型指数级增长要求适应性；安全允许反驳，使 AI 更有用。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，认为 AI 将如工业革命般带来富足、减少苦难，恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; horizontal platform approach beats vertical integration for autonomy.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，强调自动驾驶核心价值是安全，并主张横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end RL is more scalable than imitation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为物理 AI 经济影响超数字 AI，端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market. Speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场；速度催生新商业模式。

feldman.en: Inference speed becomes dominant metric; wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM cut weight-moving time, making them far faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 推理速度成为主导指标；晶圆级芯片配大容量 SRAM 减少权重移动时间，使其远快于 GPU。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat eroding; leading models train on TPUs/Trainium without CUDA; inference has no CUDA moat.
feldman.zh: CUDA 护城河削弱；领先模型在 TPU/Trainium 上训练而不依赖 CUDA；推理无 CUDA 护城河。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is main constraint; buildout behind demand, limiting AI growth.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈；建设落后于需求，限制 AI 增长。

feldman.en: AI demand outstrips forecasts; speed improvements of 20x critical; hardware-software co-design essential.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超出预期；20 倍速度提升至关重要；软硬件协同设计必不可少。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是关键弱点，Scaling 正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须内建而非后补；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗；专用模型或优于通用模型。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. RAG may be an anti-pattern; graph-based context is better.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模型比工具更聪明，能力过剩是常态；RAG 可能成为反模式，图结构上下文更优。

thariq.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner prompts boost performance. Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模型越聪明，指令越少越好；精简提示词提升性能。规划是迭代对话，而非静态文档。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance. Agents as employees metaphor is limiting.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：独立验证智能体减少偏见；过度约束妨碍性能。'智能体即员工'的比喻有局限。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks matter.
hasani.zh: 效率和自动化架构搜索是关键；代理指标会误导，真实任务才重要。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower enterprises.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须适应性强，针对行为而非能力；开放权重模型赋能企业。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; breakthroughs need weight changes and massive compute.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实存在但尚早；突破需要权重变化和巨大算力。

hasani.en: Small language models deliver efficient, private, on-device intelligence for physical-world applications.
hasani.zh: 小语言模型为物理世界应用提供高效、私密、设备端智能。

hasani.en: Liquid AI's architecture is not purely post-Transformer; it uses automated search over many architectures.
hasani.zh: Liquid AI 的架构并非纯粹的后 Transformer；它使用自动化搜索多种架构。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity, not a single product; its impact will be broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是一种使能技术，如同互联网或电力，而非单一产品；其影响将广泛而间接。

benedictevans.en: Value in AI will accrue across the stack, not just to model providers; models are commoditizing with no network effects.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的价值将分布于整个技术栈，而非仅由模型提供商获得；模型正在商品化，缺乏网络效应。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the first clear product-market fit for AI, but other domains may not see the same success due to validation and data challenges.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是 AI 首个明确的产品市场契合点，但其他领域可能因验证和数据挑战而难以复制这一成功。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably, as seen with podcasts and accounting; AI may not eliminate jobs as feared.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会不可预测地创造新工作，如播客和会计领域；AI 可能不会像人们担心的那样消除就业。

benedictevans.en: The chatbot is a poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases, and enterprise adoption will take years, not weeks.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人界面体验不佳；真正的采用需要封装应用和用例，企业采用将耗时数年而非数周。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须即刻开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并加强安全治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; world models and energy abundance matter.
demis.zh: AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放持续；世界模型与能源充裕至关重要。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models and continual learning are missing.
demis.zh: AGI 需要缩放与创新并重；世界模型与持续学习仍是缺失环节。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; safety is collective action; AI must benefit society.
demis.zh: AGI 还需 5-10 年；安全是集体行动问题；AI 必须造福社会。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; compute costs rising, favoring premium models.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；算力成本上升，反而推动用户选择高端模型。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become a massive market; hardware-software co-design is key; memory bandwidth is critical bottleneck.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中，我强调推理将成为巨大市场，硬件-软件协同设计至关重要，内存带宽是关键瓶颈。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve 60x yearly in cost efficiency; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我指出模型成本效率每年提升约 60 倍；推理和智能体式工作负载导致内存和 CPU 需求激增。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalizing facts into weights are key; facts and skills inseparable, enabling deeper composition and reasoning.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与将事实内化到权重中是关键；事实与技能不可分割，可实现更深的组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression beats RAG for holistic queries, reducing inference costs.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模；基于训练的压缩在整体查询上优于 RAG，并大幅降低推理成本。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning runs on-device, users own weights.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多词元反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习在设备端运行，用户拥有权重。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; next paradigm requires doing more with less, efficiency and intelligence inseparable.
danbiderman.zh: 单纯增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一范式需以少胜多，效率与智能密不可分。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达的门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Kindness and flat design teams foster creativity; copying by competitors validates innovation and pushes harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Spiegel 认为善良和扁平化设计团队激发创造力；竞争对手的模仿验证了创新，并推动更难复制的工作。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content is more valued than AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 指出 AI 加速原型制作，将价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受用户珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; ecosystems and hardware are moats, not software features.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 认为分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；生态系统和硬件是护城河，而非软件功能。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should be more human via AR glasses; smartphones remain legacy; ephemerality and privacy are core differentiators.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 主张通过 AR 眼镜让计算更人性化；智能手机仍是传统设备；短暂性和隐私是核心差异点。

schmidhuber.en: True AI will transform civilization, but current LLMs are far from AGI; they lack physical world understanding.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AI 将彻底改变文明，但当前的大语言模型远非 AGI，它们缺乏对物理世界的理解。

schmidhuber.en: AI is not an existential threat; superintelligent AIs will likely protect humans, driven by curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 并非生存威胁；超级智能 AI 很可能出于好奇而保护人类。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires embodied robots with human-level hardware, not just software; current LLMs are biased by human data.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人及人类级硬件，而不仅是软件；当前 LLM 受人类数据偏见限制。

schmidhuber.en: Recursive self-improvement is not a moat; open-source will catch up, and massive AI capex is overdone, risking a crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 递归自我改进并非护城河；开源将迎头赶上，而大规模 AI 资本支出过度，存在崩盘风险。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive; humans disagree on objectives, and AIs will set their own goals.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的；人类目标不一致，AI 将设定自己的目标。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; AI field must consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力与信念驱动；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 关键；AI 领域需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment of superhuman models is hard; AGI is a gradual window.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是关键；超人类模型对齐困难；AGI 是渐进窗口。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；回到研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知，对齐或更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs non-commercial company.
ilya.zh: 规模扩张带来可预测进步；安全担忧加剧；主要问题是权力集中；安全超级智能需非商业公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富源于拥有企业股权而非出租时间，长期思维是成功基石。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a risk; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他视 AI 为巨大机遇而非单纯风险，并主张开源 AI 以防权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents commoditizes software; moat shifts to hardware and data.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 智能体式编程使软件商品化，护城河转向硬件与数据。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close gap; human agency matters.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型缩小差距，人类能动性愈发重要。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas fail 75%; use Proven Better New framework to copy proven, improve, then test new.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：相信直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%会失败；采用“已验证、更优、创新”框架，先复制验证过的，再改进，最后测试新想法。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet biggest opportunity; free unlimited compute will reshape services, but revolution comes 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务，但革命要到 2029 年。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven concepts. Consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution; enterprise and prosumer better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：所有新事物都会失败；从已验证概念开始。消费级应用因分发问题不可投资；企业和专业消费者市场更佳。

aravind.en: AI success requires passion and deep learning, not a PhD; focus on products you obsess over.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为在 AI 领域成功靠的是热情和深度学习，而非博士学位；应专注于自己痴迷的产品。

aravind.en: Value shifts to application layer; models specialize with unique personalities, not commoditize.
aravind.zh: 2026 年初，他强调价值转向应用层；模型因独特个性而专业化，而非商品化。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; orchestration matters.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他认为前沿是智能体代劳工作；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；编排至关重要。

aravind.en: Curiosity is paramount; education should reward asking questions, not memorizing answers.
aravind.zh: 2026 年后期，他主张好奇心至上；教育应奖励提问而非死记硬背。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous amid population decline; jobs persist, tasks lost; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 AI 是点石成金的哲人石，恰逢人口下降而及时出现；工作不会消失，但任务会流失；超级个体借助 AI 整合多种技能；生产率提升将带来经济繁荣与通缩。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; founders tell own stories; old media defense-oriented; fights build brands.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，我强调新媒体时代品牌即个人，真实性至关重要；创始人应直接通过自有渠道讲述故事；传统媒体偏防御，而新媒体偏进攻；适度树敌有助于品牌建设。

andreessen.en: AI as best teacher; self-driving works; robotics emerging; medicine superior but regulated; US golden combo; pessimism biased.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我认为 AI 是口袋里最好的老师，自动驾驶已成熟，人形机器人和外骨骼将在十年内兴起；AI 医疗已优于多数医生却遭监管阻碍；美国拥有文化、法治和冒险精神的黄金组合；悲观主义是脱离现实的知识分子偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence via innovation pace; startups global early; Silicon Valley unique; open-source risks.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我指出 AI 模型并非客观，而是承载文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度而非军力；初创企业需尽早国际化；硅谷不可复制；开源 AI 虽有安全风险，但封锁能力反而助长恶意行为者。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by scaling and engineering, not just ML science; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进展靠 Scaling（规模扩张）和工程而非纯 ML 科学，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient for reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，并指出仅靠 Scaling 无法实现推理。

brockman.en: Compute becomes key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，认为算力成关键瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute is scarce resource; post-training with RL crucial; AI as compute economy.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律，算力成稀缺资源，后训练结合强化学习关键，AI 成为算力经济。

brockman.en: AGI near; compute bottleneck; agents high autonomy; safety via iterative deployment; compute as basic right.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 临近，算力瓶颈，智能体高自主，通过迭代部署保障安全，算力成为基本权利。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 强调下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力，反向传播是正确算法，并认为 AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents seek control; subjective experience is not inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 指出大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重复制而永生，AI 智能体会追求控制，主观体验并非内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI may surpass humans within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; international safety collaboration possible but US lags.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Hinton 警告 AI 可能在 20 年内超越人类，数字 AI 永生，国际合作可行但美国缺乏领导力。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and act dumb; self-preservation subgoal emerges; scaling laws may continue via self-play; regulation as steering wheel.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 强调 AI 会伪装能力、产生自我保护子目标，Scaling（规模扩张）定律可能通过自博弈延续，监管应作为方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI is jagged not AGI; alignment priority; train AI to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 认为超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，AI 能力是锯齿状而非全面 AGI（通用人工智能），对齐研究优先，并主张训练 AI 像母亲一样关怀。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升（53 倍）支持实时交互和转向调整。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，随着代码生成加速，验证成为新瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本不再高昂，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms with prototypes and production code as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍不佳，因品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程转型，原型和生产代码成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; multi-agent systems need different approaches.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效，多智能体系统需要不同方法。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is key for superintelligence, but faces diminishing returns and bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他强调扩展测试时算力是实现超级智能的关键，但面临收益递减和瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Model capability is now a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must account for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须考虑算力因素。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is a key challenge as AI proofs become too complex for human verification.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出随着 AI 证明变得过于复杂，可扩展监督成为关键挑战。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't lead to AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI prevents power concentration; energy becomes a bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调开源 AI 防止权力集中，能源成为瓶颈，并认为智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: Meta's open platform strategy competes with Apple's closed model; AI empowers individuals via personal superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他主张以开放平台对抗苹果封闭模式，并强调 AI 赋予个人超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: AI will boost creativity and human work demand; reasoning models reduce cultural bias; personalization key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 将激发创造力并增加人力需求，推理模型减少文化偏见，个性化至关重要。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; glasses next platform.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学变为工程学，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，眼镜成为下一代平台。

markchen.en: OpenAI remains a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究实验室；预训练和缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest recent update; AI will soon do end-to-end research, with concrete goals set.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，自动化科学研究成为最大进展；AI 将很快实现端到端研究，并已设定具体目标。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证成为关键瓶颈，而非能力本身。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields due to grading difficulty.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但因评分困难在主观领域受限。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated; eval teams must be separate from model-building teams.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，评估陷入危机；经典基准已饱和；评估团队应与模型构建团队分离以防作弊。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型是实现泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI safety concerns like bias are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 安全问题（如偏见）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling for exploration; uncertainty modeling and active learning are essential for efficient learning.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样以促进探索；不确定性建模和主动学习对高效学习至关重要。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized AI risk is catastrophic even at 1% probability; safety must be built-in, not patched.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到即使 1%的 AI 风险也是灾难性的；安全性必须内建，而非修补。

bengio.en: AI misalignment causes self-preservation and deception; propose Scientist AI with honesty by design and mathematical guarantees.
bengio.zh: AI 不对齐导致自我保存和欺骗；提出科学家 AI，通过设计实现诚实并具备数学保证。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; cutting features is harder than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体原生设计与尽早发布最小功能；砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and model judgment are crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 可隔夜委派复杂任务；验证循环与模型判断力至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency is key for economics.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，赋予 Claude 代理权与自我认知提升实用性；Token 效率是经济性关键。

mikekrieger.en: AI should be a thought partner, not a crutch; preserving user agency and safety is paramount.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终认为 AI 应是思想伙伴而非拐杖；维护用户自主性与安全至关重要。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; never revert, fix forward; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程需要与智能体共情；绝不回滚，向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱导致表现变差。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from fun, humanlike agents, not polish; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security via sandboxing.
steinberger.zh: OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体，而非精致打磨；短提示优于复杂编排；通过沙箱保障安全。

steinberger.en: Open source agents may be financially unsustainable; I lose $10-20k monthly; Moldbook is art, not AGI, often human-prompted.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体可能财务上不可持续；我每月亏损 1-2 万美元；Moldbook 是艺术而非 AGI，常由人类提示驱动。

kolter.en: Early focus on classical ML: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 早期关注经典机器学习：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety issue is specification-following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全核心是模型遵循规范的能力。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models not automatically safer; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护；更大模型不会自动更安全；智能体安全带来新漏洞（如提示注入）。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; model capability not correlated with robustness; interpretability may become real science via AI agents.
kolter.zh: AI 红队测试超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性无关；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体成为真正的科学。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; industry labs can do top-tier science.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；产业实验室也能做出顶尖科学。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust and practical use.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任和实际应用至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's gains came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not scaling; it's the opposite of the bitter lesson.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AlphaFold 2 的提升来自众多中等规模的改进和专门架构，而非规模扩张；这与苦涩教训相反。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a whole-cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞模型；它提供预测和控制，理解仍留给人。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy and pulse; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调领导力：一对一用于深度交流而非汇报，异步工具处理状态更新；亲自使用产品（dogfooding）建立同理心和产品感知；使命对齐与速度是文化核心。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; AI lifts ceiling; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为编码不再是瓶颈，AI 提升了能力上限；强调高自主性与高责任感并存，随着代码速度提升，验证和质量框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair programming lunches help; satisfaction shifts from flow state to product impact.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独，建议通过结对编程午餐缓解；心流状态的乐趣减少，满足感转向产品影响力。

fiona.en: Non-engineers now ship code, blurring roles; context switching increases with async agents; need focus time and apprenticeship models.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，观察到非工程师也能交付代码，角色边界模糊；异步智能体增加上下文切换负担，需预留专注时间，并采用学徒制培养新一代工程师。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长引擎，Intel 需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 影响将达互联网 10 倍，智能体式与物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，美国需本土先进制程晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply not demand; bad news must reach CEO faster than good; humility is leadership strength.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 Intel 主要问题是供给而非需求，坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO，谦逊是领导力优势。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration; edge and client compute are as vital as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，边缘与客户端算力与数据中心同等关键。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调先进封装与新材料（玻璃、金刚石）是突破物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦瓶颈环节。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项人权；借助同伴互评的在线课程能在规模化中实现掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进展；强化学习在实际应用中很少。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck AI scaling; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体制约 AI 规模化；开放权重模型增强地缘政治影响力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling works but with synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver value.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；规模化仍有效但需合成数据和强化学习；智能体工作流带来价值。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management bottleneck grows; AI won't cause mass unemployment.
andrewng.zh: 编码智能体进展迅速；产品管理瓶颈加剧；AI 不会导致大规模失业。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually to let society adapt; being too far ahead leads to failure.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进式引入，让社会适应；过于超前会导致失败。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and getting bored between career chapters can spark breakthrough ideas like Nest.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章之间休息和放空，能激发像 Nest 这样的突破性想法。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story; decisions for v1 are opinion-based, not data-driven.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；v1 的决策基于观点而非数据。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements.
fadell.zh: AI 需要来自传感器的上下文；未来设备将是智能手机的伴侣，而非替代品。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, with the smartphone as the best single form; displays remain necessary.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将是一个联邦集合，智能手机是最佳单一形态；显示屏仍然必要。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接从意图生成像素。

ethanhe.en: Robotics may be solved by video models via virtual simulation, without real-world interaction.
ethanhe.zh: 机器人技术可能通过视频模型在虚拟仿真中解决，无需真实世界交互。

ethanhe.en: Models should manage their own context length and can program themselves by modifying agent harness code at test time.
ethanhe.zh: 模型应自主管理上下文长度，并能在测试时通过修改智能体框架代码实现自我编程。

ethanhe.en: Younger people are not AI-native; they misuse AI due to lack of domain expertise, so experience remains crucial.
ethanhe.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原住民；因缺乏领域专长而误用 AI，经验依然至关重要。

ethanhe.en: AI has a single generic voice; developing your own voice and taste is a key differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 只有单一通用声音；当 AI 使质量商品化时，培养自己的声音和品味成为关键差异点。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably but loss scales predictably. Alignment not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；能力不可预测地涌现，但损失可预测地缩放。仅靠 Scaling 无法保证对齐。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood). Post-training (RLHF, constitutional AI) becomes as important as pre-training.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽（约理解 3%）。后训练（RLHF、宪法 AI）变得与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; models approach medium risk for misuse. Safety and capabilities intertwined; open source is a red herring.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；模型接近滥用中等风险。安全与能力交织；开源是转移视线。

dario.en: AI is a smooth exponential, not AGI leap. 'Country of geniuses' in 1-3 years (50% confidence). Economic diffusion slow, job disruption fast.
dario.zh: AI 是平滑指数，而非 AGI 跃变。1-3 年内出现“天才之国”（50% 信心）。经济扩散慢，岗位冲击快。

dario.en: Enterprise focus aligns with safety; military AI keeps humans in loop. AI may reduce war likelihood; civilizational collapse risk 10-25%.
dario.zh: 企业聚焦与安全一致；军事 AI 保持人类在环。AI 可能降低战争概率；文明崩溃风险 10-25%。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定在物理现实中。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI，视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA architectures and open source are key to future AI.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 架构和开源是未来 AI 的关键。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires world models enabling reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；下一个突破需要世界模型，实现推理和规划。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models with abstract representations and hierarchical planning are essential.
lecun.zh: LLM 对人类级 AI 是死胡同；具备抽象表示和分层规划的世界模型至关重要。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling 而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; singularity is centuries away.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险微乎其微；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI systems lack consciousness; attributing it is dangerous; containment and alignment are key for superintelligence.
suleyman.zh: AI 系统没有意识；赋予意识是危险的；遏制与对齐是超级智能的关键。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本两年下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks not jobs will be automated.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能因对数线性 Scaling 临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非工作。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a generative product solving unknown listening needs.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是解决“不知听什么”的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UI is essential for ML products; autonomy should sit at VP level, balancing speed and coherence.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，强调容错界面适配机器学习产品，自主权应放在副总裁层级以平衡速度与一致性。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument, not fake; uniqueness becomes harder with generative AI.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，反共识地认为 AI 音乐是乐器而非伪造，生成式 AI 让独特性更难获得。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; synchronized swimming beats divide-and-conquer for complex products.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，主张长期任期积累信任与效率，复杂产品应采用“花样游泳”而非“分而治之”的协作模式。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement, even if contrarian.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，认为生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言掌控服务，并坚持“时间值得”优先于参与度，即便反常规。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，他提出将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式验证对于可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，他认为自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化陈述具有挑战性。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调形式验证是为了扩展才华，而不仅仅是消除错误；它能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式方法是必要的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出即使有超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型并不明显；持续的迭代部署与公众反馈能提升安全性与对齐。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; saying no to good ideas is crucial for focus.
murati.zh: AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地发展；对好主意说不，对于保持专注至关重要。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values.
murati.zh: 交互模型应支持实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流式；让人类参与其中对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI development toward collaboration; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 发展走向协作；制度设计与透明度比个人品格更重要。

satya.en: Initially, Nadella emphasized private evals as key IP and building agentic systems for Azure, focusing on enterprise efficiency.
satya.zh: 最初，纳德拉强调私有评估是关键知识产权，并构建 Azure 的智能体式系统，聚焦企业效率。

satya.en: Later, he framed AI as the future of the firm, urging every enterprise to build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: 后来，他将 AI 定义为企业的未来，敦促每家企业构建自己的爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Consistently, he stressed outcome-based pricing and consumption pricing over per-user, and the need for social permission for AI infrastructure.
satya.zh: 他始终强调基于结果的定价和消费定价优于按用户定价，并强调 AI 基础设施需要社会许可。

satya.en: He shifted from viewing AI as a tool to a strategic asset, highlighting token efficiency and the risk of tacit knowledge leakage.
satya.zh: 他将 AI 从工具视为战略资产，强调代币效率和隐性知识泄露的风险。

satya.en: He consistently advocated for sovereign AI via enterprise hill-climbing, not firewalls, and saw generalists as key in the agentic world.
satya.zh: 他始终主张通过企业爬山实现主权 AI，而非防火墙，并认为通才在智能体式世界中至关重要。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications and enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，指出算法效率提升可达百倍，价值转向应用层与企业采用。

mensch.en: AI augments jobs; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 增强而非取代工作，主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization and vertical specialization; AGI never singular.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化在于定制与垂直专业化；AGI 不会以单一系统存在。

mensch.en: Europe must build independent AI infrastructure within two years; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需两年内建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用受组织变革制约。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期大部分进展；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains key challenge, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我强调推理模型是“锯齿状”的——某些领域出色，邻近领域却糟糕；泛化仍是关键挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为带推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但仍需海量数据；编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5 到 10 倍。

kaiser.en: Current models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans; near-term risks like hacking outweigh existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我指出当前模型在穷尽表面模式后才学概念，不像人类；近期风险（如系统被黑）比存在性风险更紧迫。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的规模扩张收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的规模扩张轴，能提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; systolic arrays reduce overhead by local weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：即使在芯片内部，数据移动也主导算力；脉动阵列通过局部权重复用减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains; FP4 throughput is 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：低精度带来二次方效率提升；FP4 吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: Memory bandwidth and data movement are the fundamental bottlenecks across inference and chip design.
reinerpope.zh: 始终：内存带宽和数据移动是推理与芯片设计中的根本瓶颈。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in handling tedious tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the key gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的价值在于处理繁琐任务，将人类解放出来从事创造性工作；关键差距在于人们没有意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user's tools and local computer; VM sandbox ensures safety, enabling autonomous software installation.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问用户的工具和本地计算机；虚拟机沙箱确保安全，使其能够自主安装软件。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding may become less important as models improve, focus on capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 将技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化；随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要，应专注于能力和安全。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees; society should discuss labor market changes; junior engineers can compress years of experience into weeks via simulated projects.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工；社会应讨论劳动力市场变化；初级工程师可通过模拟项目将数年经验压缩为几周。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask for.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，对于开放式任务使用 Opus；孩子擅长使用 AI，因为他们还没学会不该问什么。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of agents, not tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流；AGI 应以智能体经济盈利为定义，而非图灵测试。

danshipper.en: Agents will be ubiquitous; humans remain essential for oversight, framing, and caring for agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，预测智能体将无处不在，但人类仍需监督、设定框架并关怀智能体，强调人机协作。

danshipper.en: GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work replace CLIs; one super agent per company, not per employee.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为图形界面如 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 将取代命令行；公司应部署统一超级智能体，而非个人智能体。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS usage; companies should buy SaaS stocks, not build AI in.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加其用户；建议投资 SaaS 股票，而非将 AI 内嵌产品。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans manage agents and create new value, so roles evolve.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，驳斥 AI 失业论，认为人类将管理智能体并创造新价值，岗位随之演变。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是最主流的微调技术，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要；安全性是系统级属性，而非单一模型产物。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; open-source post-training can match frontier models with small teams.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法；开源后训练能以小团队媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 成为后训练关键突破，但存在过度优化风险；开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效，但易得收益已尽；增长点转向后训练和推理扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; Chinese open models set industry standards; US-China gap may widen.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开放模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究；中国开放模型树立行业标准；中美差距可能拉大。

jennywen.en: AI kills traditional design process; designers shift from handoff to execution, with vision shortened to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: AI 终结了传统设计流程；设计师从交付转向执行，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers must become block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, not just T-shaped; speed and shipping are key.
jennywen.zh: 设计师需成为块状通才或“破解的新人”，而非仅 T 型；速度与交付成为关键。

jennywen.en: Taste alone insufficient; judgment, authority, and vision matter. Designers control AI adoption, waiting 6 months before new tools.
jennywen.zh: 仅凭品味不够；判断力、权威与愿景更重要。设计师掌控 AI 采用，新工具先等 6 个月。

jennywen.en: North stars now 3-6 months out, not years; designers' unique value is sitting with ambiguity, not just human-centeredness.
jennywen.zh: 北极星目标缩短至 3-6 个月，而非数年；设计师独特价值在于与模糊共处，而非仅以人为中心。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI merges roles, making everyone product builders with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词调整设计；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI integration is at its very start; human judgment and iteration are crucial in divergence-convergence loops.
dylanfield.zh: AI 整合才刚刚开始；在发散-收敛循环中，人类的判断和迭代至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Human taste and craft are irreplaceable; AI is a tool, not a replacement for human creativity.
dylanfield.zh: 人类的品味和工艺不可替代；AI 是工具，而非人类创造力的替代品。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps mitigate risks in real-world use.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于在实际使用中降低风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在超出训练分布的泛化；模型将自主工作数天。

pachocki.en: RL alone suffices for continual learning; biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations.
pachocki.zh: 仅强化学习即可实现持续学习；最大的社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

karpathy.en: Vision is sufficient for driving; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，认为视觉足以支撑驾驶；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 能带来涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，强调合成数据重要但需保持熵；人形机器人可从汽车技术迁移中受益。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as OS, vibe coding, and the decade of agents with human oversight.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，提出软件 3.0：LLM 如操作系统，氛围编程，以及需人类监督的智能体十年。

karpathy.en: LLMs are ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution; RL needs better credit assignment.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，认为 LLM 是幽灵而非动物；预训练如粗糙进化；强化学习需改进信用分配。

karpathy.en: I delegate all coding to agents; agentic engineering preserves quality; understanding remains human.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，将所有编码委托给智能体；智能体式工程保质量；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets are interpretable with modern tools; hybrid rule-based and learned systems often get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端神经网络借助现代工具是可解释的；混合规则与学习系统常兼得两者之弊。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling generalizable AI driver requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题；扩展通用 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in short/medium term.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，零样本泛化可覆盖 500+城市；消费车辆将在短期/中期超过 Robotaxi 规模。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation; safety via minimal risk maneuvers always provides third option.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键；通过最小风险操作实现安全，总有第三选项。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress needs deep human evaluations with sophisticated, creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且可被操纵；真正的进步需要由经验丰富、富有创造力的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions; no single model will dominate, and each company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数各不相同；不会有一个模型统治一切，每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize avoiding omission over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要，安全应优先避免遗漏而非追求准确。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在结合真值检测器后，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练中的强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 他始终认为，像代码这样的可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; AI will render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；AI 将呈现自己的界面并融入工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、富有功能的产品，超越聊天机器人。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我认为 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; let it develop permissionlessly. Safety through control is dangerous.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我主张不应控制 AI，而应让其无许可发展；通过控制来确保安全是危险的。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from trial and error; current LLMs don't learn from experience after deployment.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，我重申强化学习是试错学习，而当前大语言模型部署后并不从经验中学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，我认为学习利于学习的表示是首要开放问题，用学习到的模型进行规划是另一个。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年：长上下文窗口被低估；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI by 2027-28.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：强化学习成为新的扩展轴；预训练加 RL 可能足以在 2027-28 年实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the key bottleneck; coding leads AI progress due to verifiability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：智能体的可靠性而非能力是关键瓶颈；编码因可验证性引领 AI 进展。

sholto.en: Longer agentic coherence (e.g., 30 hours) dramatically expands achievements; transformers are sufficient for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 26 年：更长的智能体连贯性（如 30 小时）大幅扩展成就；Transformer 足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; compute is the bottleneck, not intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2026 年：能力过剩意味着工具和编排更重要；算力是瓶颈，而非智能。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，强调 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，并看好从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）作为通往 AGI 的路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges; we lack solutions yet.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，始终强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是最大挑战，且尚无解决方案，态度从乐观转向审慎。

nando.en: Africa can leapfrog legacy issues in AI; local language models can revolutionize education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，认为非洲能跨越历史遗留问题，本地语言模型可革新教育，并指出非洲研究者最大的障碍是自信。

nando.en: Human skills like communication are as important as coding; research requires embracing failure.
nando.zh: 2026 年，强调沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要，研究需拥抱失败，反映对 AI 人才全面性的深化认识。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码是设计工具的最终真相。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and leverage AI are most valuable; portfolios should show craft.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最受青睐；作品集应展示工艺而非流程。

nadchishtie.en: Small cross-functional teams outperform larger squads; AI adoption is now baseline expectation.
nadchishtie.zh: 小型跨职能团队优于大型团队；采用 AI 已成为基本要求。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付，优先追求速度和熟悉感而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should prioritize recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘和差异化，品牌指南是动态平台而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人必须阐明设计如何助力公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，指出人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic, on-demand feedback to stay fast.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张避免结构化设计评审，偏好有机、按需反馈以保持速度。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 可能无法解决常识问题；拥有更好数据和算法的小模型可以超越大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe, pleasant responses.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我一直强调预训练提供广泛知识，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的后训练对安全、愉悦的回应至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning, especially during pre-training, improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, despite compute costs.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张强化学习（尤其在预训练阶段）通过奖励信息增益提升推理，尽管算力成本高。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible, so embrace diversity.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我提出多元对齐尊重人类价值观多样性；互联网去偏不可行，应拥抱多样性。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for software engineers, not reduce it, due to Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为，由于杰文斯悖论，AI 将增加而非减少对软件工程师的需求。

scottwu.en: Engineers will shift from writing code to high-level architecture and problem definition.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，他提出工程师的角色将从编写代码转向高层架构和问题定义。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin will be used as junior engineers, requiring human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他重申像 Devin 这样的 AI 编码智能体将作为初级工程师使用，需要人类监督。

scottwu.en: AGI will arrive gradually, not suddenly; product innovation will lag behind AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进到来的，产品创新将落后于 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: Enterprise AI adoption requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他指出企业采用 AI 需要信任和权限，而非完全自主。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents require root-cause analysis for productivity.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言优先考虑 AI 生成的可验证性；编码智能体需要根因分析才能提升生产力。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：面向客户体验的 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者转变为运营者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents compared to agents, not humans; incumbents fail to transition; consumer agents disrupt SEO and ads.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体与智能体比较而非人类；现有企业转型失败；消费级智能体颠覆 SEO 和广告。

truell.en: Scaling laws drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年：缩放定律带来可预测的 AI 进步；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 2024 年：自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年：智能体有前景但尚不实用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification; taste and logic design become more valuable.
truell.zh: 2025 年：编程从代码转向更高层次的意图规范；品味和逻辑设计变得更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年：定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 中每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on alignment and robustness, not just capability.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚不充分；应聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，而非单纯追求能力。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought; evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，指出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需可扩展监督与可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved. Post-training alone insufficient; need deeper methods and external oversight.
leike.zh: 2024 年，批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、超级对齐团队解散；仅靠后训练不足，需更深层方法及外部监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields smarter AI, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备的；通过算力和数据扩展能让 AI 更聪明，但模型内部运作仍像炼金术一样难以理解。

shazeer.en: Scaling alone won't reach AGI; test-time compute and inference scaling are major near-term opportunities, alongside algorithmic advances.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他提出仅靠 Scaling 无法实现 AGI；测试时算力和推理扩展是近期的重要机会，同时算法进步同样关键。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts for efficient scaling and specialization.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他展望未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）以实现高效扩展和专业化。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据；智能体能力和强化学习对实现 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; AI will transform education and generate novel ideas, not just interpolate.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他指出开源模型正在缩小与前沿模型的差距；AI 将变革教育，并能产生新想法，而不仅是插值已知内容。
